# pve_sdn_apply (Action)

Apply pending SDN configuration and reload (PUT /cluster/sdn).

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "pve_sdn_apply" "example" {
  config {
  }
}

# terraform_data is a no-op stand-in; wire action.pve actions to the
# lifecycle events of any managed resource.
resource "terraform_data" "trigger" {
  lifecycle {
    action_trigger {
      events  = [after_create]
      actions = [action.pve_sdn_apply.example]
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `lock_token` (String) the token for unlocking the global SDN configuration
- `release_lock` (Boolean) When lock-token has been provided and configuration successfully committed, release the lock automatically afterwards (default: 1)
